title: The Last Ping
objective_details: Find the Halcyon convoy's black box in HERMES by following its weak distress signal.
briefing: SRS Aegis has held a distress corridor open since the Halcyon convoy vanished. Recover its flight recorder in HERMES. It may show who turned a civilian loss into a border incident.
success: The recorder is secured. Its final ping points toward Reaver space.
failure: The signal has gone cold. Aegis will keep searching, but the trail is lost for now.

title: Keep the Lane
objective_details: Protect civilian traffic moving through THOR_PASSING.
briefing: The recorder confirms the convoy's route. Evacuating ships are crossing Thor Passing while Spartan pickets regroup. Keep the civilian traffic safe and the corridor open.
success: The last transports clear the lane. The Republic can finally answer the attack.
failure: Too many transports were lost. The route must be secured before another evacuation.

title: Aegis Holds
objective_details: Hold the marked defense zone for 60 seconds with SRS Aegis as an ally.
briefing: Reaver pressure has reached Spartan HQ. Aegis will anchor the outer defense zone while the Republic fleet closes ranks. Hold the position beside the flagship until the line is secure.
success: Aegis holds the line. The Republic will remember who stood beside it.
failure: The defense zone is lost. Aegis withdraws to regroup.

title: Scrap Tithe
objective_details: Gather wreck salvage in PIRATE_BAY and sell it at the Reaver market.
briefing: The Reavers built their fleet from other people's wreckage. Prove you can work the old way: gather salvage in Pirate Bay and sell it at our market. Your cut buys a place in the next raid.
success: The market paid out. Your name is worth remembering now.
failure: No sale, no share. The Reavers have little use for empty holds.

title: Paid in Red
objective_details: Hunt the Varn courier Scoria in GREEN_BORDER and claim the posted bounty.
briefing: The courier Scoria carried a ledger that priced Reaver crews like cargo. Find the ship in Green Border and collect the bounty. The ledger can wait; the insult cannot.
success: Scoria is down. The Reavers' price just went up.
failure: Scoria escaped. The courier will not be caught twice the same way.

title: Aegis Breaker
objective_details: Destroy SRS Aegis at SPARTAN_HQ.
briefing: The SRS Aegis has turned the Republic's safe lanes into a wall around our routes. Take the flagship out of the fight at Spartan HQ. The Reavers will settle the rest themselves.
success: Aegis is broken. The Reavers have room to run again.
failure: Aegis survives. No one gets paid for a retreat dressed as a raid.

title: The Stolen Signal
objective_details: Find the Brood-Mother's stolen brood beacon in SOLAR_FIELD by following its pulse.
briefing: The signal of a living beacon has been taken from the nest. Find it in Solar Field. The Brood-Voice offers no payment for this return; it offers the memory of who helped the young survive.
success: The beacon returns to the nest. The Brood remembers your signal.
failure: The beacon remains beyond the Brood's reach. The nest falls silent.

title: Harvesters' Debt
objective_details: Destroy 5 Varn Syndicate ships threatening THE_HIVE.
briefing: Varn harvesters followed the beacon to the Hive and cut into the outer brood. Destroy five Syndicate ships in the Hive. The Brood will answer every mark they left.
success: Five harvesters are gone. The outer brood can grow in peace.
failure: The harvesters remain. The brood must retreat deeper into the Hive.

title: Nest of Silence
objective_details: Hold the marked nest zone for 60 seconds with the Brood-Mother as an ally.
briefing: The nest is exposed while the young move below the crust. Hold the marked zone beside the Brood-Mother until the brood is safe. The Hive has no second home.
success: The nest is sealed. The Brood-Mother withdraws with the young alive.
failure: The nest is overrun. The Brood-Mother carries the surviving young into hiding.

title: The Sealed Ledger
objective_details: Deliver the sealed account crate to the station at OMICRON_PRIME.
briefing: A sealed account crate must reach Omicron Prime intact. It contains the original contract for the Reaver convoy losses, and therefore a useful kind of truth: one that can be audited.
success: The crate is logged and accepted. The numbers now have witnesses.
failure: The account crate did not arrive. The contract remains easy to deny.

title: Erase the Relay
objective_details: Destroy the Warden relay station in GREEN_BORDER.
briefing: A Frontier Authority relay is broadcasting contract records from Green Border. Destroy the station before the Warden can turn a disputed debt into a public case. The Syndicate prefers clean books and quiet borders.
success: The relay is gone. The Syndicate's version of events survives another day.
failure: The relay is still transmitting. The Warden now has the records.

title: A Price on Warden
objective_details: Destroy FAV Warden at HIGHWAY.
briefing: The FAV Warden has seized Syndicate routes and published our contracts as evidence. Remove the flagship at Highway. The Syndicate will call it a correction to the market.
success: Warden is down. The routes are open to renegotiation.
failure: The Warden remains. The Syndicate's price has become a warning.

title: Ore Arbitration
objective_details: Gather ore in ORE_BELT and sell it at the Ironclad refinery.
briefing: The belt's claims are disputed again, and the miners cannot afford another shutdown. Gather ore and sell it at our refinery. The militia will put the proceeds into keeping the rigs and crews supplied.
success: The refinery has stock. The miners can keep working another shift.
failure: The ore did not arrive. The rigs will have to idle for now.

title: Miners' Passage
objective_details: Protect civilian mining traffic in the ORE_BELT lanes.
briefing: Ore prices mean nothing if the workers cannot reach the refinery. Keep the civilian mining traffic safe in the belt. Every ship that makes it home keeps the militia supplied and the settlement alive.
success: The miners make it through. The belt stays in Ironclad hands.
failure: The traffic breaks apart. The miners pull back behind the refinery shields.

title: Bastion's Line
objective_details: Hold the marked defense zone for 60 seconds with IMS Bastion as an ally.
briefing: The Crimson Reavers are pressing toward the refinery. IMS Bastion will hold the center. Stay beside the flagship and defend the marked zone until the miners can evacuate the exposed works.
success: Bastion holds. The miners have time to get clear of the belt.
failure: The line gives way. Bastion covers the retreat from the refinery.

title: Courier's Wake
objective_details: Escort the Helion courier Lumen from HELIOSTAT to CONSTELLATION.
briefing: The courier Lumen carries drive parts needed by three Helion convoys. Escort it from Heliostat to Constellation. A late delivery costs money; a lost one costs the crews their route home.
success: Lumen reaches Constellation. The convoys can keep to schedule.
failure: Lumen did not arrive. Helion has to reroute the parts and absorb the delay.

title: Passenger Check
objective_details: Scan 4 civilian ships in TWIN_STAR to verify their transponders.
briefing: Helion's insurers flagged a cluster of inconsistent transponders in Twin Star. Scan four civilian ships and verify their records. We need to know whether the risk is paperwork or someone hiding behind it.
success: The scans are complete. Helion can price the route honestly again.
failure: The survey is incomplete. The route stays under review.

title: Forge the Suns
objective_details: Destroy Bloodforge at PIRATE_BAY.
briefing: Bloodforge has made the trade lanes too dangerous to insure. Take the Reaver flagship out of the fight at Pirate Bay. Helion will reopen the route as soon as the danger is gone.
success: Bloodforge is silent. The lanes can carry more than warships again.
failure: Bloodforge still rules Pirate Bay. Helion suspends the route for now.

title: Roadside Claim
objective_details: Hunt the Reaver raider Hex in HIGHWAY and claim the posted bounty.
briefing: Raider Hex has been preying on unarmed traffic along the Highway. Bring the ship in under the Authority's posted bounty. Frontier law starts with making the lanes safe enough to use.
success: Hex is down. The Highway is a little safer to travel.
failure: Hex escaped. The bounty remains open to the next ranger.

title: Stranded Patrol
objective_details: Rescue 3 Frontier Authority patrol pilots in DELTA_NODE.
briefing: Three patrol pilots are stranded at Delta Node after a route marker failed. Reach them and bring them back alive. The Authority does not leave its people behind to save fuel or face.
success: All three pilots are aboard and accounted for.
failure: The rescue fell short. The Authority will keep looking for its missing pilots.

title: No Safe Passage
objective_details: Destroy Syndicate Crown at OMICRON_PRIME.
briefing: The Syndicate Crown has turned Omicron Prime into a toll gate and buried the terms in private contracts. Destroy the flagship. The Frontier Authority will defend the route as public space again.
success: The Crown is down. Omicron Prime is open to civilian traffic.
failure: The Crown still controls the route. The Authority will not send another convoy through.
